decision: On first mass-apply of SCM label-mirror for deftai/directive (2026-08-08 / #1423), run visionik-first then full open apply; accept one-shot stamp plus later re-enrich (#3197/#3199); leave known hold-marker false positives as literal mirror output for dogfood rather than hand-editing labels.

governingRule.description: Classify/label-mirror is a filter and stamp surface; productize only after real dogfood evidence. Revisit triggers live in a structured decision record, not only digest comments.

alternativesConsidered.option: Skip first mass-apply until hold markers are perfect
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Blocks dogfood of re-enrich and portfolio filter paths; no real stamp data

alternativesConsidered.option: Hand-correct every hold false positive before apply
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Hides classifier failure modes that re-enrich is meant to address

alternativesConsidered.option: Treat digest comment as the only durable policy record
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Comments record what was stamped, not alternatives or revisit triggers for later agents

whyWinner: A real first-apply on the maintainer repo unblocks re-enrich design and gives portfolio/classify filter real partitions, while keeping policy reversible via explicit revisit triggers instead of silent reverse-by-next-agent.
revisitTrigger: When hold-marker false positives are fixed, re-run with --re-enrich (additive only). Do not reverse first-apply policy without new dogfood data. Do not treat the portfolio priority brief as SoT for this process choice.
